patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, featuring large, editorial-style images or solid color blocks dominating one side, balanced by text content on the other.
Distinct, full-width color blocks (white, yellow, olive, light grey) serve as background canvases to visually segment major content sections and create strong visual breaks.
Editorial-scale headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, often spanning multiple lines, creating a dramatic and impactful typographic statement.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight slide-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
Product and editorial content is presented in a flexible grid of image cards, each featuring a high-quality visual, a concise title, and a short descriptive text.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access. Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience. The initial hero image appears to have a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the page scrolls.

Full-width color blocks are used as section backgrounds to create strong visual divisions and a sense of progression. Within these blocks, content is arranged in flexible, often asymmetrical, grid layouts that pair large, high-quality images with concise text blocks, leveraging the detected swiper for image carousels and video-hero for the main banner.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) are paired with legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels, creating a clear and dramatic typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used universally for all elements, including images, cards, and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in hero and section breaks, creating an open and gallery-like feel, while internal content blocks maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, asymmetrical color blocks as backgrounds for content sections, combined with high-quality, editorial-style photography and bold, minimalist typography, creates a sophisticated and art-gallery-like browsing experience. It feels less like a typical e-commerce site and more like a curated design magazine.
